_doc: Pirate knuckles and guns (#186): tier C curated regular v83 progression, Steel Knuckler/Pistol through the Lv70 weapons (1482000-9 / 1492000-9). Event, Maple and upgraded variants excluded. Tier A: Character.wz reqLevel, reqJob and stats are read unchanged. The generic held-family filter admits only the wielded family; no shared_families entry. Late bands (#474, spec #449 C12): extended to reqLevel 120 with every ordinary v83 item of the class in Character.wz (not cash, `only`, `notSale`, `quest`, `timeLimited`, tradeBlock flags, price above 1, named, no GMS item; tier C, GAME_DESIGN 8.3); armour one per slot, reqJob, reqLevel and gender, weapons all; new items from reqLevel 41, plus Warrior and Pirate armour of 35-40 for the step-6 band.
